title: Single sign-on with SAML

requirements.text: The service provider builds an AuthnRequest, redirects to the IdP and stores the request id server-side
The response or assertion signature is verified with the IdP certificate pinned from metadata (SHA-256 or stronger), never a certificate from the message
Issuer, audience, recipient/destination and NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter are validated with small clock skew
InResponseTo must match a pending request that is then consumed; unsolicited and replayed assertions are refused
Each organization configures its own IdP (entity id, certificate, ACS) and only that IdP can sign users into it
The NameID maps to a user within that organization, with no account takeover by matching an email from another tenant

implementations.notes: Wraps node-saml and peers; behavior tests run only in examples/cookbook per-language suites. The wrapper checks InResponseTo against supplied pending ids; consuming them is the app's work

notes: Per-tenant IdP configuration, request-id storage and account mapping are not in Genlib.
